portInfo.description: South-west Norway growth port between Stavanger and Bergen. Centre is a short transfer, not a gangway stroll of zero metres — plan the kilometre.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: Terminal located close to city center
gettingThere.walkingTime: 5-15 minutes to downtown—confirm on your sailing programme before you rely on a fixed walk time.
gettingThere.distanceAnswer: Terminal located close to city center

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Do not treat Garpeskjær as zero-metre city docking — budget the kilometre each way.
